description.value: Sunny Beach Motel is a lakeside motel situated steps from Skaha Lake and Skaha Lake Park in Penticton, operated as part of the Skaha Lake Motels group of three properties. It offers studio through two-bedroom suites sleeping up to six, most with kitchenette facilities. The location puts guests within easy reach of Penticton's beach, shops, and cafes along the Skaha Lake corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active, operating motel at 3648 Parkview Street, Penticton with matching address and phone 250.492.8318. The amenities list explicitly includes WiFi and in-house laundry, and the policies page confirms this is one of three properties under Skaha Lake Motels with check-in handled at the Beachside Motel. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, or any cyclist-specific facilities anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 250-492-8318 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.

Policies page notes that check-in for all three Skaha Lake Motels properties is handled at the Beachside Motel, not on-site — arriving cyclists should be aware they may need to collect keys elsewhere.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating motel with an active website, confirmed address, and availability search — a useful stop for touring cyclists in Penticton's Skaha Lake area.

Laundry.detail: Website states guests have access to 'in-house laundry facilities'

wow_evidence: lakeside motel situated steps from Skaha Lake and Skaha Lake Park... in-house laundry... one of three properties under Skaha Lake Motels
